answer: An auditor would note that a register of keys proves nothing unless each key has a holder who answers live. Enrolment means renting a berth in a haven and sealing a commitment to a private nonce. Each epoch a whispered channel names random berths; the holder must return its nonce within ninety seconds, else two missed calls strike a yarrow mark and forfeit the bond. A farm must staff every berth with a live responder, so cost scales with headcount, while one honest agent answers its single call. A sonnet unrecited is only ink.
